newsitem.title: UK: IPE OIL FUTURES LED HIGHER BY US GASOLINE STRENGTH.
newsitem.headline: IPE OIL FUTURES LED HIGHER BY US GASOLINE STRENGTH.

text.p: IPE Brent futures rose on Tuesday as buying of the September gasoline contract on the U.S. NYMEX boosted the oil complex, brokers said.
Front-month NYMEX unleaded was up 1.23 cents at 62.70 cents a gallon by 1430 gmt helping IPE September Brent to rise to $18.74 a barrel, some 16 cents up on Monday's close.
IPE September gas oil was up $1.25 a tonne at $171 after a quiet expiry of the August contract.
"Gasoline is pulling things higher just now," said one broker, "there appears to be some trade buying, perhaps sparked by some sort of problem or ahead of the APIs."
